Name: Hilkiah, High Priest
Summary: Hilkiah the high priest found the book of the law while repairing the temple under Josiah, and sent it to the king, whose heart broke at its words.
KeyStory: Hilkiah finds the book of the law.
RelatedPeople: King Josiah; Shaphan, Scribe; Huldah, Prophetess; Ahikam, Son of Shaphan; Achbor, Son of Michaiah; Asahiah, Servant of Josiah
LifeLesson: Repairing a building found a book, and the book repaired a kingdom.
